notes: NOTES TO THE ACCOUNTS THAT READ LIKE PUBLISHED ACCOUNTS; A STATEMENT OF CASH FLOWS BY CAPTION; WHOEVER CHANGES A VOUCHER CANNOT APPROVE IT; EVERY PAYMENT PAYS EXACTLY WHAT IT POSTS. The notes are numbered as published accounts are, with a Before-these-notes-are-signed checklist on screen, items to confirm highlighted, and new notes for related parties, commitments and events after the reporting date; the Statement of Financial Position lists non-current assets first. The cash flow is by caption, each line opening to its vouchers, with project funds net and a reconciliation note. Whoever changes a colleague's voucher, recurring template or corrected voucher cannot approve it; a voucher is approved only through Approve. A payment's net cash must equal what it takes from the bank; the supplier bank file and cheques follow it; supplier bank details are as approved. Stale cheques: more double-payment routes closed. Payroll for a year keyed late, month by month. The Help guide covers all of it. Installing: database changes (0255–0262) that alter no posted figure. Please take a backup first: Backup and Export, Back up now. Carries everything in 0.8.152.
